name: Pop Roxx 1g Pre-Roll
description:
Lineage: Blue Zkittlez x Gelato

Type: Indica-dominant Hybrid

Terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene and Caryophyllene

Aroma: Ripe berries, pine, and sugary sweetness

Effects: Euphoria, Mood Boost, Creative, Body Relaxation 

Pop Roxx is a flavor firework with a chill encore. Bred from Blue Zkittlez x Gelato, this indica-dominant hybrid bursts with ripe berries, sugary sweetness, and a snap of fresh pine. Fueled by limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, it kicks things off with a bright wave of euphoria and creative spark before settling into a smooth, body-melting relaxation that keeps the good vibes popping.
